features.featureTitle: In frontend/src/components/ChapterForm.tsx, replace both Audio 1 and Audio 2 file upload inputs (and their associated progress bars, file-upload state, and chunked-upload logic) with plain text URL input fields. Audio 1 must have a text input for the audio URL (placeholder: 'Audio 1 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)') and an adjacent optional label field (placeholder: 'Audio 1 Label'). Audio 2 must have a text input for the audio URL (placeholder: 'Audio 2 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)') and an adjacent optional label field (placeholder: 'Audio 2 Label'). Remove all File state variables, chunked-upload calls (uploadAudioChunk, uploadAudioChunk2, finalizeAudioUpload, finalizeAudioUpload2), upload progress state, and upload progress bar UI elements related to audio. The Save button flow must no longer perform any audio upload steps — chapter metadata (including the two audio URL strings and their labels) is saved directly via createChapter or updateChapter. Saving a chapter with only a title must still work; all audio URL fields remain optional.

Update the Chapter page Audio tab in frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx and the AudioPlayer component in frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx to play audio using the stored URL strings (audioUrl, audioUrl1, or audioUrl2 fields on the Chapter object) directly — without fetching binary data from the canister. When a chapter has one or two audio URLs, the Audio tab must show named buttons/cards for each available audio item using the admin-entered label (audioLabel1 / audioLabel2), falling back to 'Audio 1' / 'Audio 2'. Clicking a named button passes the corresponding URL string directly to the AudioPlayer for playback. Remove any calls to getAudioData or getAudioData2 canister functions, and remove any URL.createObjectURL / URL.revokeObjectURL logic that was used for binary audio blobs. The AudioPlayer must accept the URL as-is and attempt playback, displaying an error message only if the browser cannot load the resource. If no audio URL is stored for either slot, show the existing 'No audio available' empty-state UI.

Update frontend/src/utils/chapterMapper.ts to map the audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 backend fields to the frontend Chapter type, and update frontend/src/types/chapter.ts to include audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 as optional string fields on the Chapter interface. Remove any frontend references to hasAudio, hasAudio2, or binary audio blob fields that were used for the chunked upload feature.
